evidence.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave , kāyapassaddhi, cittapassaddhi. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为令未生之轻安觉支生起，已生之轻安觉支修习圆满之食？诸比丘，有身轻安(kāyapassaddhi)、心轻安(cittapassaddhi)。于此，多作如理作意——此为令未生之轻安觉支生起，已生之轻安觉支修习圆满之食。
evidence.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of tranquility, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of tranquility? There are, monks, tranquility of body and tranquility of mind. Therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of tranquility, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of tranquility.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: ‘Antogadhānaṃ pabhedā’ ti dukkhasaccasmiñhi, ṭhapetvā taṇhañceva anāsavadhamme ca, sesā sabbadhammā antogadhā; samudayasacce chattiṃsa taṇhāvicaritāni; nirodhasaccaṃ asammissaṃ; maggasacce sammādiṭṭhimukhena vīmaṃsiddhipādapaññindriyapaññābaladhammavicayasambojjhaṅgāni. Sammāsaṅkappāpadesena tayo nekkhammavitakkādayo, sammāvācāpadesena cattāri vacīsucaritāni, sammākammantāpadesena tīṇi kāyasucaritāni, sammāājīvamukhena appicchatā santuṭṭhitā ca, sabbesaṃyeva vā etesaṃ sammāvācākammantājīvānaṃ ariyakantasīlattā sīlassa ca saddhāhatthena paṭiggahetabbattā tesaṃ atthitāya ca atthibhāvato saddhindriyasaddhābalachandiddhipādā, sammāvāyāmāpadesena catubbidhasammappadhānavīriyindriyavīriyabalavīriyasambojjhaṅgāni, sammāsatiapadesena catubbidhasatipaṭṭhānasatindriyasatibalasatisambojjhaṅgāni, sammāsamādhiapadesena savitakkasavicārādayo tayo tayo samādhī, cittasamādhisamādhindriyasamādhibalapītipassaddhisamādhiupekkhāsambojjhaṅgāni antogadhānīti. Evamettha ‘antogadhānaṃ pabhedā’pi vinicchayo veditabbo.
entries.chinese_simplified: “‘内摄之分别’：于苦谛中，除渴爱与无漏法外，其余诸法皆为内摄；于集谛中，有三十六种渴爱行相；灭谛不与他法混杂；于道谛中，以正见为首，内摄观神足、慧根、慧力、择法觉支；以正思惟为代表，内摄出离思惟等三者；以正语为代表，内摄四种语妙行；以正业为代表，内摄三种身妙行；以正命为首，内摄少欲、知足；或因正语、正业、正命皆为圣者所爱之戒，戒又当以信之手接受，且因其存在与现起，故内摄信根、信力、欲神足；以正精进为代表，内摄四正勤、精进根、精进力、精进觉支；以正念为代表，内摄四念处、念根、念力、念觉支；以正定为代表，内摄有寻有伺等三种三摩地，以及心神足、定根、定力、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。如是，于此亦应知‘内摄之分别’的抉择。
entries.english: 'The classifications of what is included' – In the truth of suffering, except for craving and the taint-free states, all other states are included. In the truth of origin, the thirty-six modes of craving are included. The truth of cessation is unmixed. In the truth of the path, by way of right view, the basis of psychic power of investigation, the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, and the enlightenment factor of investigation of states are included. By way of right intention, the three thoughts of renunciation and so on are included. By way of right speech, the four kinds of good verbal conduct are included. By way of right action, the three kinds of good bodily conduct are included. By way of right livelihood, having few wishes and contentment are included. Alternatively, since all these—right speech, right action, and right livelihood—are virtue dear to the noble ones, and since virtue is to be received with the hand of faith, their existence establishes the faculty of faith, the power of faith, and the basis of psychic power of aspiration. By way of right effort, the fourfold right exertions, the faculty of energy, the power of energy, and the enlightenment factor of energy are included. By way of right mindfulness, the four foundations of mindfulness, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, and the enlightenment factor of mindfulness are included. By way of right concentration, the three kinds of concentration—with applied and sustained thought, and so on—are included, along with concentration of mind, the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, and the enlightenment factors of joy, tranquility, concentration, and equanimity. Thus, the analysis of 'the classifications of what is included' should also be understood in this way.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Bojjhaṅgakosallaṃ pana ‘‘evameva kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāyā’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.234) saṃyuttamahāvagge bojjhaṅgasaṃyutte āgatameva.
entries.chinese_simplified: 至于觉支善巧，则如《相应部·大品·觉支相应》中所说：“诸比丘，当心沉滞时，非是修习轻安觉支之时。”（《相应部》5.234）
entries.english: But skill in the factors of enlightenment is found in the Saṃyutta Nikāya, Great Chapter, in the Connected Discourses on the Factors of Enlightenment, as follows: “So too, bhikkhus, when the mind is sluggish, that is not the time to develop the enlightenment factor of tranquility.” (SN 5.112)

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.english: For the enlightenment factor of tranquility—

entries.pali: Kāyacittadarathavūpasamalakkhaṇā passaddhi eva yathāvuttabodhiaṅgabhūto passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, tassa passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa evaṃ uppādo hotīti yojanā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 以身心苦恼的止息为特征的轻安(passaddhi)，即是如前所述作为菩提分的轻安觉支。此是对此轻安觉支如何生起的解释。
entries.english: Tranquility, whose characteristic is the calming of bodily and mental agitation, is itself the tranquility enlightenment factor, which is a factor of awakening as stated. The connection is that the arising of that tranquility enlightenment factor occurs thus.

entries.pali: ‘‘Yasmiñca kho, bhikkhave, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. Taṃ kissa hetu? Uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi suvūpasamayaṃ hoti. Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa, so tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni…pe… paṃsukena ca okireyya, bhabbo nu kho so puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetunti. Evaṃ bhante’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.234).
entries.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，当心掉举时，这时是修习轻安觉支的时候，是修习定觉支的时候，是修习舍觉支的时候。此为何故？诸比丘，掉举的心通过这些法能够很好地平息下来。譬如，诸比丘，如果有人想要熄灭一个大火堆，他就会在那里撒上湿草……乃至……用尘土覆盖它，此人能否熄灭那个大火堆呢？”“诚然，尊者。”
entries.english: “Monks, when the mind is agitated, that is the time to cultivate the enlightenment factor of tranquility, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and the enlightenment factor of equanimity. Why is that? Because an agitated mind, monks, is easily calmed by these states. Suppose, monks, a man wanted to extinguish a great mass of fire. He would throw wet grass on it… and sprinkle it with dust—would that man be able to extinguish the great mass of fire?” “Yes, venerable sir.” (Saṃ. Ni. 5.234)

entries.pali: Etthāpi yathāsakaṃ āhāravasena passaddhisambojjhaṅgādīnaṃ bhāvanāsamuṭṭhāpanāti veditabbā, tattha passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanā vuttā eva. Samādhisambojjhaṅgassa anantaraṃ vakkhati. Paññāpayogamandatāyā ti paññābyāpārassa appabhāvena. Yathā hi dānaṃ alobhapadhānaṃ, sīlaṃ adosapadhānaṃ, evaṃ bhāvanā amohapadhānā. Tattha yadā paññā na balavatī hoti, tadā bhāvanā pubbenāparaṃ visesāvahā na hoti, anabhisaṅkhato viya āhāro purisassa yogino cittassa abhiruciṃ na janeti, tena taṃ nirassādaṃ hoti, tathā bhāvanāya sammadeva avīthipaṭipattiyā upasamasukhaṃ na vindati, tenāpi cittaṃ nirassādaṃ hoti. Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘paññāpayoga…pe… nirassādaṃ hotī’’ ti. Tassa saṃveguppādanaṃ, pasāduppādanañca tikicchananti taṃ dassento ‘‘aṭṭha saṃvegavatthūnī’’ tiādimāha. Tattha jātijarābyādhimaraṇāni yathārahaṃ sugatiyaṃ, duggatiyañca hontīti tadaññameva pañcavidhabandhanādikhuppipāsādi aññamaññaṃ vibādhanādihetukaṃ apāyadukkhaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ, tayidaṃ sabbaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ paccuppannabhavanissitaṃ gahitanti atīte anāgate ca kāle vaṭṭamūlakadukkhāni visuṃ gahitāni. Ye pana sattā āhārūpajīvino, tattha ca uṭṭhānaphalūpajīvino, tesaṃ aññehi asādhāraṇaṃ jīvikādukkhaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ saṃvegavatthu gahitanti daṭṭhabbaṃ. Ayaṃ vuccati samaye sampahaṃsanā ti ayaṃ bhāvanācittassa sampahaṃsitabbasamaye vuttanayena saṃvegajananavasena ceva pasāduppādanavasena ca sammadeva pahaṃsanā, saṃvegajananapubbakapasāduppādanena tosanāti attho.
entries.chinese_simplified: 此处亦应知，轻安等觉支的修习生起，各依其相应资粮，其中轻安觉支的修习已经说过，定觉支接着将说。所谓“慧行迟钝”，即智慧作用微弱。如同布施以无贪为首，持戒以无嗔为首，修习则以无痴为首。当智慧不够有力时，修习便不能由前导后，引生殊胜，犹如未经调理的食物，不能令瑜伽行者的心生起爱好，因此索然无味；同样，若修习不能正确地循道而行，便不能获得寂止之乐，心也因此无味。故说：“慧行……乃至……索然无味”。其对治之法，在于令生悚惧与净信，为示此义，故说“八悚惧事”等。其中生、老、病、死，随其所在，或于善趣，或于恶趣；此外，应知尚有五种系缚等、饥渴等、互相逼恼等为因的恶趣之苦。这一切皆依于彼彼众生的现在世生存而取，至于过去、未来时中，以轮回为根之苦则分别而取。又，有些众生需依食物维生，且依劳作成果维生，他们有别于他人的活命之苦，当知此为第八悚惧事。这称为“适时欣悦”，即修习之心在应当欣悦之时，依前述之法，通过令生悚惧与净信而善为欣悦，其义为：以生起悚惧为先，而后生起净信，从而使心满足。
entries.english: Here too, the development and arising of the enlightenment factors such as tranquility should be understood according to their respective nutriments. In this context, the development of the tranquility enlightenment factor has already been explained. The concentration enlightenment factor will be discussed next. Due to weakness in the application of wisdom—that is, due to the weakness of the activity of wisdom—just as generosity is rooted in non-greed, and virtue in non-hatred, so too is development rooted in non-delusion. When wisdom is not strong, development does not bring successive distinctions; like unseasoned food that fails to delight the mind of a meditator, it becomes joyless. Similarly, through improper practice of development, one does not find the bliss of peace, and so the mind remains joyless. Hence it is said, 'Due to weakness in the application of wisdom... it becomes joyless.' To show that generating a sense of urgency and generating confidence are the remedies for this, the text states, 'The eight grounds for urgency,' etc. Here, birth, aging, sickness, and death occur as appropriate in both good and bad destinies; distinct from these, the suffering of the lower realms—caused by the fivefold bondage, hunger, thirst, and other mutual afflictions—should be understood. All this is taken as dependent on the present existence of those beings, while sufferings rooted in the cycle of rebirth in the past and future are taken separately. As for beings who live by food and depend on the fruits of their efforts, their unique suffering of livelihood is to be understood as the eighth ground for urgency. This is called 'gladdening at the proper time.' This means the proper gladdening of the mind in development at the time it should be gladdened—in the way described, by means of generating a sense of urgency and by means of generating confidence. The meaning is that it is satisfied by the generation of confidence preceded by the generation of urgency.

entries.pali: 35 . Satta bojjhaṅgā – satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo vīriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
entries.chinese_simplified: 35. 七觉支(bojjhaṅgā)：念觉支、择法觉支、精进觉支、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。
entries.english: 35. Seven enlightenment factors: the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of investigation of dhammas, the enlightenment factor of energy, the enlightenment factor of rapture, the enlightenment factor of tranquility, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and the enlightenment factor of equanimity.

entries.pali: Satta bojjhaṅgā (vibha. 466) – satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo vīriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo. Bojjhaṅgavibhaṅgaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 七觉支（《分别论》466）——念觉支、择法觉支、精进觉支、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。觉支分别。
entries.english: The Seven Enlightenment Factors (Vibh. 466): the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of investigation of dhammas, the enlightenment factor of energy, the enlightenment factor of rapture, the enlightenment factor of tranquility, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and the enlightenment factor of equanimity. The Analysis of the Enlightenment Factors.

entries.pali: Saṅgahavāre pana bodhipakkhiyadhammesu pubbe saṅgahitāvasesānaṃ satipaṭṭhānasammappadhānaiddhipādabojjhaṅgānaṃ vasena atirekā cattāro saṅgahā veditabbā. Paṭhamajjhānikamaggasampayuttesu hi dhammesu sati upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satipaṭṭhānaṃ, sā visayabhedena catubbidhā, itare assatipaṭṭhānāti sabbeva te dvidhā honti. Tathā vīriyaṃ padahanaṭṭhena sammappadhānaṃ, taṃ kiccabhedena catubbidhaṃ, itare asammappadhānāti. Tathā chando vīriyaṃ cittaṃ amohoti cattāro dhammā ijjhanakaṭṭhena yathākkamaṃ ‘‘chandiddhipādo vīriyacittavīmaṃsiddhipādo’’ti nāmena ‘‘iddhipādā’’ ti vuccanti, itare ‘‘aniddhipādā’’ti. Tathā sati amoho vīriyaṃ pīti passaddhi samādhi tatramajjhattatāti ime satta dhammā bujjhanaṭṭhena yathākkamaṃ ‘‘satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo vīriyapītipassaddhisamādhiupekkhāsambojjhaṅgo’’ti vuccanti, itare abojjhaṅgāti evaṃ cattāro saṅgahā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 在摄要品中，然而，在菩提分法中，除了先前已摄取者之外，依念处、正勤、神足、觉支，应知有四种额外之摄要。在初禅道相应之法中，念以安住之义为念住，彼依所缘之差别有四种，其余者则非念住，如是彼等皆为二种。同样，精进以努力之义为正勤，彼依作用之差别有四种，其余者则非正勤。同样，欲、精进、心、无痴此四法，依成就之义，依次以“欲神足、精进神足、心神足、观(vīmaṃsā)神足”之名，称为“神足”，其余者则非“神足”。同样，念、无痴、精进、喜、轻安、定、中舍此七法，依觉悟之义，依次称为“念觉支、择法觉支、精进觉支、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支”，其余者则非觉支。如是则有四种摄要。
entries.english: In the section on inclusion, regarding the aids to enlightenment, four additional inclusions should be understood by way of the remaining factors not previously included: foundations of mindfulness, right strivings, bases of spiritual power, and enlightenment factors. For in the states associated with the first-jhāna path, mindfulness is the foundation of mindfulness by virtue of its establishing nature; it is fourfold by division of objects, while the others are not foundations of mindfulness—thus, all are twofold. Similarly, energy is right striving by virtue of exertion; it is fourfold by division of function, while the others are not right strivings. Likewise, zeal, energy, consciousness, and wisdom—these four phenomena, by their meaning of accomplishing, are called 'bases of spiritual power' in sequence by name as 'the base of spiritual power of zeal, the base of spiritual power of energy, the base of spiritual power of consciousness, and the base of spiritual power of investigation'; the others are not bases of spiritual power. Similarly, mindfulness, wisdom, energy, joy, tranquility, concentration, and equanimity—these seven phenomena, by their meaning of awakening, are called 'enlightenment factors' in sequence as 'the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, the enlightenment factor of energy, the enlightenment factor of joy, the enlightenment factor of tranquility, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and the enlightenment factor of equanimity'; the others are not enlightenment factors. Thus, there are four inclusions.
